title: Roche earmarks $750M to double the size of its Oregon manufacturing facility
llm_note: Roche is investing $750 million to double the size of its Genentech manufacturing facility in Hillsboro, Oregon.

title: Xspray's Dasynoc approval bid foiled again by FDA's manufacturer concerns
llm_note: Xspray Pharma's drug approval was rejected by the FDA due to unresolved contract manufacturer concerns.

title: B. Braun recalls IV solution from US, Canada hospitals on particle contamination concerns
llm_note: B. Braun Medical initiated a product recall due to particle contamination found in its IV solution.

title: Medigen Vaccine Biologics advances enterovirus vaccine
llm_note: Medigen Vaccine Biologics is partnering with Charles River Laboratories to validate a virus seed bank for vaccine production.
